limits: A same-call evidence ledger is not a RewardKit checkpoint.
Forced waits do not prove overrun of 9000 seconds (150 minutes).
Static reductions and fixture serialization do not measure model/tool latency or full browser workflow completion.
The source audit is mechanical and does not replace the separate semantic guard or golden/partial-feature execution.
